row.body: The sales receipt marks a car delivered, while the test-drive log starts after its keys were returned. A note asks whether the fuel charge belongs to the buyer.
row.title: The car with no return trip

sidecar.gloss: A vehicle is marked delivered before its test drive is logged.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency transport could also create a delayed fuel charge and key return; the record does not identify the drive.

row.body: the toothbrush and bath towel are wedged beneath unused warning tape. footprints pass around the bundle rather than toward it.
row.title: missing count beside the toothbrush

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
